what_happened: Scene: layout/style 10; two tomatoes and two fish (fish_7, fish_8) on the glass fridge shelves. Trip 1: grasped the large tomato veg0 at 56-64 (lift 0.275 m) and turned right from the fridge to the marble corner counter next to the microwave/utensil holder (148-200). No tupperware is on that counter (none visible in any frame I checked; packet distance to the nearest tupperware 2.27 m at release). It held the tomato at counter-edge height in front of that counter for ~220 steps (200-420) without placing it; at ~427 the tomato slipped out of the fingers (close event 419, width 0.002) and fell to the floor (436, end z 0.03). With closed empty fingers (432-1864) it then hovered at that corner for ~1450 steps, the wrist camera mostly looking at the tomato on the floor (448-1950). At ~1950-2040 it went back to the fridge and grasped fish meat0 at 2083 (lift 0.026 relative to the shelf), carried it to the same tupperware-free corner (2200) and held it there until the end (still held at 2600, 2.47 m from the nearest tupperware).
causal_chain: drove the first item to the wrong counter (no tupperware there, ~2.3 m from the tupperwares) -> hovered holding it 200-420 -> tomato slipped to the floor 427 -> ~1450 steps hovering with closed fingers over the dropped tomato -> second item (fish, 2083) carried to the same wrong place and held to timeout -> 0 items placed
self_recovery: It eventually (after ~1500 steps) went back for a second item, but took it to the same wrong counter.
